merchant/30181.htm.text: Merchant Galibredo: Where are you from, youngster? What are you looking for? No, no, I'm not talking about goods... I want to know why you came here... Sorry -- I'm not speaking very clearly. Never mind! Can I help you find anything today?

merchant/30181-pk.htm.text: Merchant Galibredo: You seem cursed... The smell of death is upon you. You should leave now. Can't have the likes of you around, bad luck. You are surely not long for this world... Beleth cannot say he lived long...

A few months ago, hundreds of her works were excavated in Innadril. "Galfredo Romer's Bust" was one of them. He was one of my ancestors who was as an aid to the Emperor! …

Q00355_FamilyHonor/30181-09.html.text: Trader Galibredo: I'm counting on you! Go punish those dastardly thieves and recover my precious antiques.
